high_alert_reason: ISMP high-alert: paralyzing agent. Administration without adequate sedation causes awake paralysis. Must be paired with induction sedative; airway management and mechanical ventilation must be ready.
adult_dose: RSI: 1.0–1.2 mg/kg IV push. Maintenance: 0.1–0.2 mg/kg q20–30min or infusion 0.01 mg/kg/min.
renal_adjustment: Duration prolonged in renal failure; reduce frequency of maintenance doses.
hepatic_adjustment: Duration prolonged in severe hepatic dysfunction (primary hepatic elimination).
max_dose: Per-dose: 1.2 mg/kg RSI. No absolute ceiling on total; titrate to response.
indications: Maintenance of paralysis during mechanical ventilation
contraindications: Inadequate sedation plan (absolute — must have induction sedative and post-intubation sedation ready)
Airway and ventilation equipment not immediately available
key_monitoring: Train-of-four (TOF) monitoring during continuous infusion (target 1–2/4 twitches)
Depth of sedation (RASS, BIS if available) — must not paralyze an awake patient
Eye protection and repositioning while paralyzed

provenance.source: ACLS RSI algorithm + ISMP high-alert list + Lexicomp summary
provenance.note: Preferred over succinylcholine in hyperkalemia and in patients at risk for malignant hyperthermia.
